mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(charge_money) AS tradeAmount FROM order_list WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT order_status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_list WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY order_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, SUM(charge_money) AS totalTradeAmount, SUM(charge_amount) AS totalChargeAmount, ROUND(AVG(charge_time), 0) AS avgChargeTime FROM order_list WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND charge_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(o.charge_money) AS tradeAmount, SUM(o.charge_amount) AS chargeAmount FROM order_list o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND o.pile_code IN ( SELECT pile_code FROM charging_pile WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 )
GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT o.order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM order_list o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND o.pile_code IN ( SELECT pile_code FROM charging_pile WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 )
GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, SUM(charge_money) AS totalTradeAmount, SUM(charge_amount) AS totalChargeAmount, ROUND(AVG(charge_time), 0) AS avgChargeTime FROM order_list o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND o.pile_code IN ( SELECT pile_code FROM charging_pile WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_list o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.order_status = '已完成' AND o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND o.pile_code IN ( SELECT pile_code FROM charging_pile WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 )
